semanticInvariants: Only explicit eligible production publications are discoverable.
Real provider save and bootstrap paths write the same strict canonical publication metadata.
Publication mutation is explicit, concurrency-checked, and notifies only after commit.
Catalog and routing identities are deterministic while private provider state remains absent from public JSON.
Cache correctness derives from persisted state and current eligibility, not process-local observer state.
Conditional GET, path-specific errors, and access-context validation are protocol-correct.
Catalog-read and invoke remain separate least-privilege scopes.
Secret deletion and provider saves cannot create dangling publication inputs.
Dependency direction remains Abstractions inward, Http outward, Workspace policy-owned, and Web transport-only.
positiveEvidence: Exact publication/catalog, catalog API, and authorization selections discover 18/14/10 and pass 18/14/10 after implementation.
Real Workspace save persists canonical metadata, re-evaluates eligibility, and supports explicit publish/unpublish with post-commit invalidation and activity.

The native and OpenAI models routes expose a canonical sanitized representation with stable public/routing identities, strong ETag, private caching directives, request IDs, and truthful OpenAPI headers.
A force-refreshed CodeAnalytics snapshot records exactly the planned 14-project/33-reference graph with no new cycle or error finding.
negativeEvidence: Disabled, malformed, synthetic, imported, fallback, unknown, non-execution, missing-secret, unsupported-transport, and non-production descriptor profiles fail closed.
Malformed and mixed-wildcard conditional headers, malformed access context, missing/malformed/expired/wrong-scope tokens, and controlled catalog failures return safe path-specific responses.
Serialization and static scans exclude internal provider ID, base URL, secret identifiers/values/names, raw configuration, notes, and raw upstream health detail.
A deterministic concurrent secret-delete/provider-save interleaving cannot leave a dangling reference; a missing target secret fails before persistence or notification.

The frozen 14/10 Web cardinalities were strengthened after implementation with expired-JWT, controlled-service-failure, production-descriptor-matrix, mixed-wildcard, and OpenAPI header-schema assertions.
The frozen 18 unit cardinality was strengthened with real save-path metadata, deterministic secret lifecycle, bounded health mapping, and explicit must-not-call test guards.
CP-03 remains open: SB03 completes only the central publication/catalog/API half, while SB04 owns inference POST relay and dispatch proof.
No broad, browser, multi-instance, paid-provider, live-network, remote source-sync, inference POST, or UI lane ran.
